stack.tanstack_table: none (UTable used directly in one place; no standalone @tanstack/vue-table dep)

local_reimplementations.name: admin/index.vue menu editor
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled category+item CRUD list: card-per-item with inline edit form, active/inactive badge, save/delete buttons; loading state ('Loading menu items...'), empty state; no pagination (fetches all items via GET /api/admin/menu unbounded, client-filters by category).

local_reimplementations.name: AdminPriceEditor
local_reimplementations.notes: price-variant key/value sub-editor used twice inside admin/index.vue's item cards (existing items + new-item form).

local_reimplementations.name: admin/users.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: user list rendered as <ul>/<li> cards (name, admin badge, email, created date, reset-password button), add-user UForm, password-reset UModal, useToast() notifications. GET /api/admin/users has no page/limit params and the server route (index.get.ts) does an unbounded db.select().from(users).all() — fetches every user every load.

local_reimplementations.name: admin/gsc.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled Google Search Console performance page. Contains a REAL native <table class="admin-table"> (line 260) with an inline `eslint-disable narduk/no-native-table -- raw HTML table needed for GSC data display with custom styles`, bypassing this repo's OWN local ESLint rule (eslint-plugins/rules/no-native-table.mjs, 'atx/no-native-table': disallow <table>, use <UTable> instead) because UTable reportedly couldn't achieve the needed styling (right-aligned tabular-nums numeric columns).

local_reimplementations.name: admin/analytics.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled Google Analytics overview page; not table-rendered (cards/metrics), backed by server/api/admin/ga/overview.get.ts.

local_reimplementations.name: admin/posthog.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled PostHog analytics page (insights/recordings/devices/entry-exit/pages/referrers), the single largest admin page in the app; backed by 6 separate server/api/admin/posthog/*.get.ts routes.

defect_history.summary: Template-layer exit onto narduk-libs (harmony#87 pattern) — web foundation contract §4

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionTable (raw-table variant)
top_extraction_candidates.why: this repo has its OWN local ESLint rule (atx/no-native-table) mandating UTable over raw <table>, yet had to eslint-disable it here because UTable couldn't produce the right-aligned tabular-nums numeric-column styling needed for search-console metrics — direct evidence for what a shared table component must support out of the box

top_extraction_candidates.name: AdminUsersTab-equivalent (already exists in narduk-auth)
top_extraction_candidates.why: full re-implementation of a component narduk-auth already ships (AdminUsersTab); also fetches all users unbounded (no page/limit) which a shared component with built-in pagination would fix for free

top_extraction_candidates.name: Admin analytics panel trio (already exist in narduk-analytics)
top_extraction_candidates.why: re-implements AdminGaOverviewPanel, AdminGscPerformancePanel, AdminPosthogPanel from scratch instead of consuming narduk-analytics; single biggest LOC block in the app (posthog.vue alone is 768 lines)

notes: Richest of the three apps surveyed. Zero narduk-libs component adoption despite the admin surface substantially re-implementing three components narduk-libs already ships by name (AdminUsersTab, AdminGaOverviewPanel, AdminGscPerformancePanel, AdminPosthogPanel) — this looks like the app predates those packages or was never migrated off the legacy analytics/auth template layers. The gsc.vue raw-<table> eslint-disable is the strongest single piece of evidence in this lane for a concrete UTable styling gap a shared table must close. Two server list endpoints (admin/users, admin/menu) are unbounded (no page/limit at all), consistent with small data volumes today but a real gap if either list grows.
